tests.command: nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/ltx25-b70/stream/ops -p test_stream_ops.py -q

review: Independent read-only agent review; reported naming, path, stale-unit, process-drain, readiness identity and timeout issues corrected. Final review found no remaining safety blockers. Sink-only halted-packet archive regression added afterward.
scope: CPU only. Actual systemctl, journalctl, curl, health probe, launchers, client and sink were never invoked. Tests substitute temporary executables and an injected clock. Shell wrappers exercised only with bash -n and --help; CLI dispatch also tested with injected mock paths.
operational_prerequisite: Coordinator-reviewed units must have KillSignal=SIGINT, KillMode=control-group, SendSIGKILL=no. Frozen client/sink launchers currently omit SendSIGKILL=no. No live settings changed.
scratch_cleanup: All test TemporaryDirectory contexts cleaned their owned ltx-ops-cpu-* scratch; no Python bytecode written.
